description: Android release build gates: R8 minify, Autobackup excludes for corruptible save slots, CI assembleRelease.

signing.note: CI and local assembleRelease sign with the debug keystore until a Play upload key is configured.

backupExcludes.reason: Save slots are AtomicFile-rotated and recovered in-app; Autobackup of a mid-write latest can corrupt both slots. Entitlements restore via billing stub/Play.
